mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as it reduces discount rates for equity valuation and stimulates economic activity through cheaper credit conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5% (based on rolling 3-year window).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced consumer spending and corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.5%) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate weakening consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations and lower economic growth forecasts.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases (Rank IC < 0.02) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing industrial production, defined as a monthly decline exceeding 0.5% in the industrial production index, signals a contraction in manufacturing output and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced corporate earnings and economic slowdown expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO monthly change is below -0.5% (over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A rising employment level in the non-farm payroll series predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as it reflects economic resilience and increased consumer spending capacity through higher disposable income.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS is rising (over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1000 thousand units signal a contraction in the housing sector, which negatively impacts S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced construction activity and consumer confidence decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1000) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining industrial production level predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as it indicates reduced manufacturing output and potential economic slowdown through lower corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is declining (over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent negative GDP growth and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL above 3% annualized) signal stagflation, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through reduced corporate profit margins and increased market volatility.
failure_condition: The joint signal of negative GDPC1 and CPIAUCSL > 3% fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases (Rank IC < 0.01) over any 3-year rolling window.
